interpretation: The frozen whole-document semantic threshold is not calibrated for a corpus in which every document intentionally asserts the same proposition. Shared target semantics creates many high-cosine edges and a giant transitive component even though the highest-cosine pairs have little verbatim 5-gram overlap. This result measures the intended shared proposition more than copy-level duplication.
retention_decision: Accepted by the experiment owner on 2026-08-27: retain all 9,600 documents because the whole-document MPNet threshold is confounded by the intentionally shared target proposition.
